name: cold-email
description: Find leads with Firecrawl and Apollo, write personalized cold emails, and upload them to Instantly.

instantly_api_key.title: Instantly API key
instantly_api_key.description: From Instantly Settings > Integrations > API. Used to upload leads and emails.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API key (optional)
firecrawl_api_key.description: From firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys. Leave blank to use Firecrawl's free keyless tier; a key unlocks your plan's credits and full toolset.
